name: Sparkle Kids Planet
tagline: English nursery songs and learning songs for little ones everywhere.
about: English 3D animated kids channel: nursery rhymes, learning songs (colours, numbers, shapes, animals, good habits), bright playful world. Cast to be locked — add character sheets in Brand.
audience: Kids 2–6 worldwide and their parents. Made for Kids.
visual_style: 3D Pixar-style animation, 4K, bright candy colours, soft daylight, NOT photorealistic.
suno_style: English nursery rhyme, playful ukulele, xylophone, claps, light drums, cheerful kids choir with warm female lead, call and response, 115 BPM, clear simple English, no EDM
song_rules: Very short lines, lots of repetition, one learning idea per song, actions kids can copy (clap, jump, point). Hook in the first 5 seconds.
publish_rules: Titles: keyword first (e.g. 'Colors Song'), then '| Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs', year tag. Description with timestamps and lyrics. Made for Kids, Category Education.

research.brief: Niche: English nursery rhymes and learning songs, a huge and competitive niche (Cocomelon, Super Simple Songs, Little Baby Bum). Find small-channel outliers and specific learning topics with high views/day.

notes: Characters are not locked yet. Upload character sheets in Brand before the first images.
scene_len_note: Scene length in seconds. Match it to your clip tool: Grok/Vibes make ~6 s clips; Wan 3.0 can make any length.

packaging.title_pattern: "<Main keyword song> <1–2 emoji> | <hook phrase> | Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs <year>" — keyword first in English.
packaging.geo: USA first, then UK, Canada, Australia, India and the Philippines (English nursery-rhyme search words: kids songs, nursery rhymes, toddler learning, baby songs).

thumb_rules: One big friendly character face, bright primary colours, 2–3 big English words (yellow or white, thick dark outline), never over a face; toddler-friendly, very simple background.
